svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Frame bearer (back in the sketch): RHS 60 x 40 x 4, 1,048 mm, with an

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 8 x 80 x 80 mm end plate welded on each end: overall 1,064 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 13 mm holes per end plate, 20 mm in from each edge; they

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: match the cleats on the trusses. M12 grade 8.8 bolts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The frame bearers sit at both deck ends and at the three splices,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and make each pair of verticals and the floor a stiff U-frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Panel bearer (front): SHS 40 x 40 x 3, 1,080 mm, top flush with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: chord tops; held by 50 x 50 x 5 angle cleats and 2 x M10 each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hangers for the line shaft: 6 mm plate under each frame bearer,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 380 mm right of the middle (see the drive sketch).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: tops of all bearers level with the chord tops within 1 mm.
